title: Performance Report Pack
description: Phase 4.9 — the post-campaign performance report generated when the deal's `performance_capture_window_ends_at` is reached. Aggregates KPIs captured during the performance window (from `deal.delivery.interim_kpi_snapshots[]`) into a final snapshot + benchmark comparisons + LLM-drafted narrative analysis. Soft agent gate; sending IS approval. On send, `deal.close.final_performance_report_attachment_id` + `deal.close.final_kpis` are auto-populated — both required for the deal's auto-archive into Phase 1.5 brand_deals. Stored at `data/deals/{deal_id}/performance_report_packs/v{N}.json` (gitignored). See `docs/performance_report_workflow.md`.

performance_report_pack_id.description: Globally unique. Format: `perf_{deal_id_short}_v{N}`. The `perf_` prefix distinguishes from prep / proposal / contract / invoice packs.

trigger.description: auto_on_performance_window_end: cron fired generation when `performance_capture_window_ends_at` reached. agent_initiated: agent fired before window end (rare). agent_*regenerate: NL feedback regen. kpi_refresh: cron re-fired because new KPI data arrived after initial generation (e.g. platform API late-reporting).

pre_generation_guidance.description: Free-text guidance from agent before generation.

contract_pack_id_at_gen.description: Which executed contract this report measures performance against.

proposal_pack_id_at_gen.description: Which proposal pack defined the brand's stated objectives (for `vs_brand_stated_targets` benchmark).

deal_proposal_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of relevant `deal.proposal.*` fields (fee_usd, deliverables[], usage_rights_granted, exclusivity) for performance vs. spend analysis.

discovery_debrief_snapshot.description: Frozen copy of `deal.lead.discovery_debrief.objectives_heard[]` so the report can measure against what the brand actually said they wanted.

comparable_brand_deals_for_benchmark.description: FK list to past `brand_deals` records used for `vs_talent_historical` benchmark (same talent's prior similar deals).

platform_apis_used.description: Which platform APIs the KPI capture cron pulled from. Manual entry recorded when API was unavailable or talent's account wasn't connected.

kpis.description: Aggregate final KPIs across all deliverables. Each metric carries source provenance per honesty-floor. Shape mirrors `brand_deal.kpis` from Phase 1.5 — on agent send, these values copy verbatim into `deal.close.final_kpis` (which then carries into brand_deal.kpis on auto-archive).

per_post_kpis.description: Per-deliverable KPI breakdown. Each post in the campaign gets its own row with platform-Insights-fetched metrics + capture timestamp. Aggregate sums into the top-level `kpis` block.

captured_at.description: When this post's KPIs were last refreshed from the platform API.

kpis.description: Per-post KPIs. Same kpiMetric shape as the aggregate block.

benchmark_comparisons.description: Per-KPI comparison against three benchmark sets. Computed at generation time. Each entry is human-readable for direct rendering into the report.

vs_industry.description: Per-KPI comparison against industry benchmarks (from `data/industry_kpi_benchmarks.json` — v2 data file). Map keys = KPI names (matching `kpis.*`); values = comparison record.

vs_talent_historical.description: Per-KPI comparison against the talent's average across `comparable_brand_deals_for_benchmark[]`. Same shape as vs_industry.

vs_brand_stated_targets.description: Per-KPI comparison against brand's stated targets (extracted from `discovery_debrief.objectives_heard[]` or proposal's commercial rationale). Often empty if brand didn't specify numeric targets.

narrative_sections.description: LLM-drafted prose. Default sections: executive_summary (3-line top-line outcome) + what_worked (which deliverables outperformed + why) + learnings (recommendations for future campaigns). Each section cites context paths it drew from.

composed_markdown.description: Final assembled report markdown (executive summary + KPI tables + benchmark callouts + narrative sections + per-post breakdown). Source-of-truth for the PDF render.

agent_review.description: Soft gate. Agent reviews rendered PDF before sending. Sending sets sent_at and triggers the downstream writes (final_performance_report_attachment_id + final_kpis on deal.close). All fields optional — absence of sent_at means the report is in draft.

sent_at.description: When agent sent report to brand. Setting this auto-populates `deal.close.final_performance_report_attachment_id` (= report.pdf path) AND copies this pack's `kpis` into `deal.close.final_kpis`. If `deal.close.all_invoices_paid_at` is also set, auto-archive fires.

kpiMetric.description: Same shape as `brand_deal.kpiMetric`. On agent send of this report, these values write verbatim into `deal.close.final_kpis` and ultimately into `brand_deal.kpis` on auto-archive.

benchmarkComparison.description: One KPI's comparison against one benchmark set.

performance_label.description: Human-readable summary, e.g. '2.3x category average', '+29% vs talent's historical', '94% of target'. Rendered directly into the report.

benchmark_source.description: What the benchmark was. For vs_industry: source data file. For vs_talent_historical: list of deal_ids averaged. For vs_brand_stated_targets: where in the debrief the target was stated.
